run_autotrain_setup: run the autotrain setup command to install or uninstall xformers for the environment
run_setup_colab: run the autotrain setup command with the colab flag to install xformers for google colab
run_setup_update_torch: run the autotrain setup command with the update torch flag to install the latest pytorch
register_setup_subcommand: register the setup subcommand with argparse to add update torch and colab arguments
create_run_setup_command: create a run setup command instance with update torch and colab boolean flags
